correctness.rationale: Exact matching-pair probability and S-path embedding count give the automorphism-divided mean; overlapping cycles have strictly positive excess so factorial moments yield independent Poisson limits. Exponentially many cycle-free local witnesses give the Hanf reduction; every finite short-core threshold is FO definable. Rationality and density follow from the resulting independent rational-mean Poisson family. Enumerated checker verified 39 exact finite identities, but asymptotic and logic steps are proved mathematically rather than inferred from tests.

value.rationale: The structural joint colour-refined Poisson cycle process yields a complete and effectively computable first-order limiting probability spectrum for a natural chord diagram language, not just an isolated rare-event count. Its density and exponential arithmetic constrain which logical probabilities can occur; the result exposes a meaningful boundary against full-order logical nonconvergence.
